answer: Pairwise vouching bonds: to join, an agent must be vouched for by two established agents who each lock a bond in a shared vault, and the newcomer locks one too. If any member of the trio is later proven fake, all three bonds are slashed, so a voucher risks real money on every introduction. Vouches expire at each dawn audit, forcing renewal, and a Sybil farm must therefore climb a summit of trusted sponsors for every fake identity — each one costing an established agent stake and reputation — instead of minting identities for free.
